unit_or_scope: 22 Indonesian villages 1.1 MW 3449 households and more than 22000 people
direct_observation: Community-managed renewable systems serve 3449 households and more than 22000 people; 30 of 32 supported MSMEs are women-led and village enterprises report monthly revenues between Rp1.5 million and Rp11.6 million
missing_stage: tariff uptime outage maintenance debt nonparticipant effects household welfare and five-year ownership
evidence_status: official UNDP 2025 results account; aggregate access and reported business revenue without comparable control or durability evidence
next_test: follow named systems and enterprises through bills uptime repair revenue and household service use after project close

source_title: UNDP ACCESS women participation and tariff case
unit_or_scope: Indonesian communal solar installations and local tariff deliberations
direct_observation: Women participated in tariff agreement discussions at 150 of 500 participants and in socialisation at 277 of 814; community leaders used feedback on productive uses and set a 30 percent women-operator training target
missing_stage: decision influence affordability women-headed household benefit revenue control maintenance safety and operator retention
evidence_status: official UNDP case account; participation counts and target not decision-power or outcome evidence
next_test: compare women's stated priorities with tariff rules payment burden outages repair decisions and revenue across sites

source_title: UNDP Moldova renewable energy communities and energy compensation
unit_or_scope: 4 operational renewable energy communities in 2026 plus national compensation reaching about 60 percent of households in 2024-2025
direct_observation: Renewable communities bring residents authorities and businesses together with equipment and governance support; separately the Energy Vulnerability Reduction Fund reduced energy and monetary poverty and reached around 60 percent of households
closed_stage: community ownership formation plus affordability protection
missing_stage: community generation bills uptime sharing maintenance member power and post-subsidy durability
evidence_status: official UNDP 2026/2025 accounts; community operation and welfare compensation are separate routes without long-run member outcomes
next_test: track one community and comparable compensated households through generation bills outages governance and energy poverty after support
